newsitem.title: UK: Air Hong Kong extends air cargo agreement with London Cargo Group.
newsitem.headline: Air Hong Kong extends air cargo agreement with London Cargo Group.

text.p: Air Hong Kong has extended its cargo handling agreement with London Cargo Group for three years beyond January 1997, the Cathay Pacific group company said.
AHK has signed a separate contract with London Cargo subsidiary MANCargo Handling to handle its cargo at Manchester from Nov 16.
London Cargo which is part of BOC Group has warehousing and office space at Heathrow, Birmingham and Manchester airports.

AHK operates scheduled Boeing 7447-200 freighter services from Hong Kong to Manchester and Brussels stopping at Dubai west and east bound five times a week and plans to add a sixth weekly flight in 1997. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+44 171 542-5017
